how_to_reach: Srisailam is located in Nandyal district of Andhra Pradesh and accessible by road from major cities.
To reach Umamaheshwaram (Northern Gateway), travel via the Hyderabad-Srisailam road, alight at Munnanooru or Rangapuram, and travel 3 km to upper/lower Umamaheshwaram.
To reach Siddhavatam (Southern Gateway), travel 20 km from Kadapa via Badvelu road across Penna river in YSR Kadapa district.
To reach Pushpagiri (South-West Gateway), travel 18 km from Kadapa in Valluru Mandal, YSR Kadapa district via auto/bus.
To reach Sangameswaram, travel 55 km from Kurnool or 20 km from Nandikotkur to Machhumarri (16 km from Nandikotkur), or take bus from Atmakuru to Kapileshwaram, or boat ride from Somashila.

nearest_railway_station.name: Markapur Road Railway Station (MRK)
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Well connected to Guntur, Vijayawada, and South Central Railway routes. Kurnool City (180 km) and Nandyal (160 km) are major alternative stations.

nearest_airport.name: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA), Hyderabad
nearest_airport.connectivity: Well connected nationally and internationally. Kurnool Airport (Orvakal) is ~170 km away.

bus_routes: APSRTC and TGRTC bus services connect Srisailam with Hyderabad, Kurnool, Markapur, Atmakuru, Kadapa, Nellore, and surrounding districts.
Special RTC bus services operate to Sangameshwaram during Mahashivaratri when the submerged temple resurfaces.
road_routes: Kadapa-Badvelu Road (20 km from Kadapa for Siddhavatam)
Kadapa-Valluru Road (18 km from Kadapa for Pushpagiri)
Kurnool-Nandikotkur-Machhumarri Road (55 km from Kurnool for Sangameshwaram)
parking_info: Large parking facilities managed by Devasthanam near CRO, Ring Road, and Patalaganga entrance.
